title.rendered: Sound Crush Boom Portable Bluetooth Speaker

content.rendered:
Boom Portable Bluetooth Speaker

Features

All-Terrain Durability: From water to mountains, sand to forests, and even snow, the IPX7 waterproof rating ensures that the Sound Crush Boom is ready for any adventure. Carry it effortlessly with the included lanyard cable.
TWS Technology: Enjoy seamless connectivity with Bluetooth 5.0 and hands-free operation, and elevate your audio experience by connecting two units via TWS for a combined 20W output!
Superb Sound Quality: Immerse yourself in crystal-clear audio with extremely deep bass thanks to the dual passive radiators, delivering a stereo output of 10W. With up to 15 hours of playtime, the party never has to end!
Ultra-Portable Design: Designed with adventure in mind, the compact size of the Sound Crush Boom Portable Bluetooth Speaker makes it the perfect companion for cycling trips and outdoor excursions. Take your music wherever you go!

Sustainable/ Eco Friendly Materials

At the heart of eco-friendly portable speakers lies a commitment to sustainable materials. Manufacturers are increasingly opting for recycled or renewable resources in the construction of speaker components. From bamboo and cork to recycled plastics and aluminium, these materials offer a blend of durability, aesthetics, and eco-friendliness.
